findings.description: Rounding logic for negative amounts does not handle half values correctly; negative results are rounded towards zero instead of away from zero.
findings.evidence: candidate.percent_of(-1, 50) == 0 but expected -1, because -1*50/100 = -0.5 should round to -1.

review.summary: The implementation incorrectly rounds negative amounts, failing to round halves away from zero and violating the contract that percent_of(-x, p) == -percent_of(x, p).
